p: Bitcoin steht bei 80.242 Dollar, +0,0 Prozent in 24 Stunden und -3,2 Prozent in einer Woche.
Ethereum liegt bei 2.328 Dollar, +0,0 Prozent am Tag.
Der Gesamtmarkt ist 2,80 Billionen Dollar schwer, Bitcoin macht davon 57,5 Prozent aus.
Angst und Gier steht bei 50 von 100.
16 Prozent der 301 größten Coins liegen über ihrer 50-Tage-Linie, 25 Prozent über der 200-Tage-Linie.
Die Mehrheit liegt unter ihrem Durchschnitt. In solchen Phasen sind Erholungen meist kurzlebig.
Der durchschnittliche RSI liegt bei 33, also überverkauft.
Im Stablecoin-Markt liegen 303,9 Milliarden Dollar. In den letzten sieben Tagen sind 1,3 Milliarden Dollar abgeflossen.
In DeFi-Protokollen stecken 87,7 Milliarden Dollar. Vorn liegen Ethereum (48,5 Milliarden Dollar), Base (6,0 Milliarden Dollar), BSC (5,8 Milliarden Dollar).
Vorn liegt L2 mit +94,8 Prozent in sieben Tagen über 23 Coins.
Am schwächsten ist DePIN mit -6,1 Prozent.
Die Spanne zwischen stärkstem und schwächstem Sektor beträgt 101 Prozentpunkte. Es ist also kein Markt, in dem alles gleich läuft.
Die höchsten Gesamt-Scores haben KAVA (78), BNB (74), ASTER (74).
Größte Tagesgewinner über 100 Millionen Marktkapitalisierung: AKE +11,4 Prozent, BEAM +11,3 Prozent, ENA +10,3 Prozent.
Auffällige Divergenz bei KAVA: Über beiden Durchschnitten, RSI 62 im gesunden Bereich. Trend ohne Übertreibung.
Beim Social Buzz führen ARIA (86), SUI (84), DRV (83).
Bei den Hidden Gems stehen oben: RPL (70), SPK (70), SYRUP (68), ORCA (66).
Eine Bitcoin-Überweisung kostet gerade 1 Satoshi pro Byte für die schnelle Bestätigung.
Die Rechenleistung im Netzwerk hat sich in 30 Tagen um +7 Prozent verändert.
Bis zur nächsten Halbierung der Blockbelohnung sind es noch 76.781 Blöcke. also rund 533 Tage.

btc.zyklus: Das letzte Bitcoin-Halving war am 20.04.2024, das ist 30 Monate her. Bitcoin steht 36 % unter dem Allzeithoch. In den bisherigen Zyklen kam das Hoch rund 12 bis 18 Monate nach dem Halving, danach folgte ein längerer Rücksetzer. Es sind nur 3 bis 4 Zyklen, die Aussage ist eine Hypothese und kein Naturgesetz.

stimmung.herde_text: Die Herde ist unentschlossen. Kein Kontra-Signal, hier zählen Chart und Fundament mehr als die Stimmung.
lage: Angst und Gier steht bei 50 (Neutral): keine Extremlage.
Stablecoin-Umlauf −1,67 Mrd $ in 30 Tagen. Kapital verlässt das System.
Makro: Leitzins 3,88 %, Rendite 10 Jahre 4,96 %. Hohe Realzinsen belasten Risikoanlagen (Hypothese, die in vielen Phasen galt).

news.t: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback
news.z: US spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with $301 million in net inflows after a strong three-day start gave way to heavy withdrawals.

news.t: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.z: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.t: Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
news.z: The warning comes as Gartner forecasts that more than 80% of specialist cloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030.

news.t: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
news.z: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

news.t: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
news.z: A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.

news.t: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
news.z: The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.

news.t: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
news.z: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

news.t: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets days after CEO called breach reports a ‘false alarm’
news.z: CEO Sumit Gupta had told X users on Wednesday that early reports of a breach sounded like "a false alarm."

news.t: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
news.z: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

news.t: Keystone customers say breach exposed data the hardware wallet maker promised to delete
news.z: Keystone has said it deletes customer information 180 days after their orders in most cases, though X users have cast doubt on that claim.

news.t: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
news.z: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

news.t: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
news.z: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

news.t: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
news.z: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

news.t: Crypto longs lose $404 million in four hours as bitcoin briefly slips below $80,000
news.z: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $773 million on Thursday and Friday after three days of net inflows, per SoSoValue data.

news.t: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
news.z: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

news.t: Argentine judge clears Milei and 10 others in LIBRA case, finding no ‘criminally relevant deception’
news.z: The judge's 60-page ruling concluded Argentine President Javier Milei's post promoting the LIBRA token did not, by itself, establish fraud.

news.t: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
news.z: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.

news.t: Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
news.z: Robert Bowling, who spent six years working on Call of Duty, told Decrypt that Activision suggested cutting discs nearly two decades ago.

news.t: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
news.z: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

news.t: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
news.z: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

news.t: NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme
news.z: Bitcoin Magazine NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme Two successive crypto frauds took investors for more than $1.1 billion. Now New York's attorney general is asking a court

news.z: Bitcoin Magazine Blockstream Launches Institutional Consulting Services, Opens Lugano Office Blockstream will offer its engineering expertise to banks and asset managers from a new Swiss base. This post Blockstream Launc

news.t: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
news.z: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.

news.t: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
news.z: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.
